rich_description: The Fresh Start Housing Scheme is HDB's second-chance flat ownership path for low-income families with young children who are currently living in a public rental flat and previously owned an HDB flat but lost it (typically through divorce, financial difficulty, or forced sale). It offers a 2-room Flexi flat on a shorter lease with a substantial Fresh Start Housing Grant (up to $75,000) to bring monthly mortgage instalments down to a level the family can sustain — usually less than what they would otherwise pay in rent. Families must commit to a Fresh Start Employment and Children's Development plan, which means staying employed and ensuring children attend school regularly, monitored by a social service caseworker. This is designed for families stuck in the rental flat cycle who want a stable, owner-occupied home again. If you and your spouse are in your 30s or 40s, have school-age children, are renting from HDB, and previously owned a flat that you lost — this is the scheme to ask about.

other_criteria: At least one Singapore citizen applicant; spouse must be citizen or PR
Currently living in an HDB public rental flat
Have at least one Singapore citizen child below 16
Family previously owned an HDB flat (second-timer)
Must commit to Fresh Start Employment and Children's Development plan
Assessed and recommended by HDB and the assigned social service caseworker

required_documents.name: Proof of current HDB rental tenancy
required_documents.notes: Tenancy agreement or rental account statement

required_documents.name: Income documents
required_documents.notes: Recent payslips, CPF contribution history, or income tax NOA

oth_location: Level 3, HDB Tampines Branch (Customer Service Counters). Application is also coordinated through the Family Service Centre social worker assigned to the family.
typical_processing_time: Caseworker assessment 4-8 weeks; Fresh Start approval and flat allocation typically 3-6 months end-to-end.
